extracted.name: Best Cheese Sauce
extracted.description: This straightforward cheese sauce is as easy to make as it is versatile; serve on sandwiches, vegetables, or pasta!
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat. Blend in flour and cook until mixture is smooth and bubbly, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in half-and-half, Cheddar cheese, salt, pepper, and cayenne. Return to heat and cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is smooth, about 5 minutes. Keep warm until serving.
